title: Functional diversity of phage sponge proteins that sequester host immune signals
authors: Hadary R; Chang RB; Béchon N; Tal N; Osterman I; Yirmiya E; Garb J; Amitai G; Kranzusch PJ; Sorek R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究噬菌体海绵蛋白结合并隔离宿主免疫信号分子的功能多样性，虽涉及蛋白-小分子信号结合及结构建模，但对象为蛋白-代谢物互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或分子动力学模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Multiple bacterial immune systems, including CBASS, Thoeris, and Pycsar, employ signaling molecules that activate the immune response following phage infection. Phages counteract bacterial immune signaling using sponge proteins that bind and sequester the immune signals, but the breadth of immune signals targeted by phage sponges is unclear. Here we study the functional versatility of Acb2, Tad1 and Tad2, three families of sponge proteins known to inhibit CBASS and Thoeris signaling. Eighty-four proteins representing the phylogenetic diversity of these sponge families were tested for their ability to inhibit immunity by sequestering 3′3′-cGAMP and 3′3′-cUA (CBASS), cCMP and cUMP (Pycsar), and 3′cADPR, His-ADPR and N7-cADPR (types I, II and IV Thoeris, respectively). While Acb2 proteins were so far reported to inhibit only CBASS systems, we found Acb2 homologs that bind 3′cADPR and inhibit Thoeris defense. In addition, we discovered sponge proteins that inhibit Pycsar and type IV Thoeris by binding cUMP and N7-cADPR, respectively. Using crystal structures, structural modeling and biochemical analyses, we explain the molecular basis for signal-binding specificities in members of these sponge families. Our study reports the first sponges inhibiting Pycsar and type IV Thoeris, and demonstrates how phage sponges evolve to obtain diverse specificities.
abstract_zh: 多种细菌免疫系统，包括CBASS、Thoeris和Pycsar，利用信号分子在噬菌体感染后激活免疫反应。噬菌体通过海绵蛋白（sponge proteins）结合并隔离免疫信号来对抗细菌免疫信号传导，但噬菌体海绵蛋白所靶向的免疫信号范围尚不清楚。在此，我们研究了Acb2、Tad1和Tad2这三个已知抑制CBASS和Thoeris信号传导的海绵蛋白家族的功能多样性。我们测试了代表这些海绵家族系统发育多样性的84种蛋白质，通过隔离3′3′-cGAMP和3′3′-cUA（CBASS）、cCMP和cUMP（Pycsar）以及3′cADPR、His-ADPR和N7-cADPR（分别为I型、II型和IV型Thoeris）来抑制免疫的能力。尽管迄今为止报道Acb2蛋白仅抑制CBASS系统，但我们发现了结合3′cADPR并抑制Thoeris防御的Acb2同源物。此外，我们发现了通过分别结合cUMP和N7-cADPR来抑制Pycsar和IV型Thoeris的海绵蛋白。利用晶体结构、结构建模和生化分析，我们解释了这些海绵家族成员中信号结合特异性的分子基础。我们的研究首次报道了抑制Pycsar和IV型Thoeris的海绵蛋白，并展示了噬菌体海绵蛋白如何进化以获得多样化的特异性。
